Prepare your response before Naptime puts you to sleep. Counterspell is a timed answer to the telegraphed application; save it for that moment rather than opening poke. Uncaught teammates should protect the sleeping target and pressure enemies preparing the follow-up. Once you wake, move toward cover instead of restarting an isolated duel.
